problem: A full native DOC/DOT table audit found real language/recognizer state, deprecated table-character caches and empty author-parallel review-thread tables behind historical UI-limited rows. Native recognizer snapshots then exposed three validation defects: rejecting the admitted producer terminal, requiring absent bookmark tables, and accepting disconnected staged CP ranges.
changes: Match the existing reader terminal rule in smart-tag snapshot validation. Actual range starts and nonterminal ends stay bounded; a candidate cannot invent or retarget an out-of-domain source terminal.

Validate encoded bookmark/recognizer table lengths only when their complete optional owners are present. Retain the all-or-none bookmark-group check and reject recognizer metadata without its FIB table.

Require neighboring recognizer ranges to share one CP boundary before staging. Duplicate-CP point ranges remain valid. Adjacent boundary changes can be made together through the clone-first update API.

Add seven indexed native semantic tests and one evidence-only full-corpus audit. Record seven absent families as reviewed fixture gaps without positive credit, update the evidence-accounting guard and correct the smart-tag matrix API name from Transaction to Edit.

verification_scope.corpus_inventory: All 20 native DOC/DOT files, including the password-backed encrypted source, expose a 20-byte PlcfTch and a 48-byte or 60-byte RmdThreading. Exactly nine have language-detection and smart-tag recognizer state. No native factoid bookmark/property store is claimed.
verification_scope.table_cache: Every file has pinned main-story ccpText, entries (0,known) and (ccpText,unknown), and terminal ccpText+2. Typed encoding matches an independently constructed five-u32 wire vector and, for all unencrypted sources, the original native bytes. This is retained deprecated cache data, not cache regeneration or document interpretation.
verification_scope.threading: Each file has one empty message ID/display/style slot, or two for review-controls and tracked-moves, parallel to exact author catalogs. Empty display metadata is None and table lengths are pinned. Nonempty message identity, timestamp and email-thread behavior remain unqualified.
verification_scope.language_and_recognizer_reads: Text, East Asian and layout-template parents have complete pinned CP/state sequences and direct PLC-byte comparisons. NoLad language ranges remain distinct from Dirty recognizer ranges; template recognizer subdivisions remain distinct from language subdivisions. The complete native snapshot catalog additionally checks all nine record counts and exact no-op opening of all 19 unencrypted sources, including absent and recognizer-only graphs.
verification_scope.recognizer_edits: Existing native state changes through parts::smart_tags::Snapshot/Edit. Exact semantic no-op/replay/inverse, stale conflict, disconnected-range refusal with valid staging retained, unchanged FIB and the source terminal are checked. A duplicate-CP point range publishes correctly; out-of-domain range starts and terminal retargets refuse precisely without damaging staging.
verification_scope.language_edits: Detached ProofingStateTable editing changes only the first language state to Clean. Spelling, grammar and recognizer metadata remain exact. Detached language-table removal is also checked without implying a dedicated proofing package transaction.
verification_scope.publication: The public CFB owner publishes the explicit record edits. Only the selected same-length table range changes; all other stream bytes, stream keys, directory type/CLSID/state bits/timestamps, document text and original package bytes are retained. File save/reopen and exact artifact replay/inverse pass. Macro/encrypted variants are covered by native reads/no-ops; changed recognizer examples use the three native parents that contain the selected records.
verification_scope.absence_reviews: All 20 sources have zero lengths and absent public reads for Hplxsdr, SDT bookmarks, format-consistency bookmarks, text-service UIM/GUID tables, current/legacy grammar cookies/data, repair bookmarks and PGPArray. Reviews doc-002/003/004/005/006/010/015 specify the exact missing native records and preserve their uncovered status.
verification_scope.limits: No language detection, smart-tag recognizer service, schema resolution, email action, macro execution, active cache use or fresh Word validation occurs. Changed publications are library edits of native saved metadata. The seven absent owner families still require native specimens; zero lengths and neighboring features are not positive payload evidence.

specification_evidence.source: User-supplied local full specification plus the tracked native bytes and existing reader contract
specification_evidence.finding: CPs delimit adjacent saved-state ranges, duplicate CPs can represent points, and the final CP only terminates the preceding range. The fix preserves the native terminator already admitted by the reader without allowing edits to expand its special role.

specification_evidence.reference: [MS-DOC] 2.5 FIB range definitions, 2.8.29 PlcfTch, 2.9.320 Tch and 2.9.230 RmdThreading
specification_evidence.finding: FIB lengths distinguish absent owners; the table-character cache is passive/deprecated, and RmdThreading has author-parallel metadata that can contain empty message slots. Tests do not interpret these records as an active service or email conversation.
